column1: #   STATUS = SAFE  → the handler reads a body and accesses it raw, but is in fact
#                    guarded in a shape the regex classifier can't see (typically a
#                    guard inside an IMPORTED validator). --check ignores these.
# A handler listed here is one a human has CONFIRMED safe. A genuinely-unguarded
# handler must NOT be added here — fix it (route through readJsonBody /
# coerceObjectBody, or guard the parsed body) so the gate passes legitimately.
